summary: Athena Technology Acquisition Corp. II filed an 8-K disclosing it deposited $497.74 into its trust account to extend the deadline to complete its initial business combination by one month, from May 14, 2026 to June 14, 2026. This is the ninth and final of up to nine permitted monthly extensions. No specific target, terms, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is a routine SPAC extension notice, mapping to a US blank-check company periodic disclosure. Watch for whether the SPAC announces a definitive agreement before the extended deadline or faces liquidation.
